title: Made a choose your own adventure game
author: Infinite-Aioli-6274
selftext:
I'm not totally sure if this belongs here, technically it's a game - but not as cool as most of the stuff I see here.

Each book has about 22 endings, you have to finish the books in order. There is an overarching mystery about the book's missing author. Certain paths you choose in the book lead to mini arcade games. Once a game has been discovered, it also unlocks inside the Starcade where it can be replayed as a full endless version.

I made this for my daughter and her friends to play around with.

I had opus and sol tag team this over the weekend. I connected them to my magnific mcp to generate all the book illustrations. I used 3.js for all the 3d stuff. 

[https://www.thelostarchive.net/](https://www.thelostarchive.net/)
